# Federico Gambedotti

Federico Gambedotti is a London-based PhD researcher at University College London, startup builder, writer, and co-host of the 2Humans podcast. His work focuses on energy equity, community energy, flexibility, demand reduction, artificial intelligence, and institutional design.

## Main sections

- Home: https://fgambedotti.github.io/
- Research: https://fgambedotti.github.io/research.html
- Building: https://fgambedotti.github.io/building.html
- Writing: https://fgambedotti.github.io/writing.html
- Podcast: https://fgambedotti.github.io/podcast.html
- About and contact: https://fgambedotti.github.io/about.html

## Current work

- Research: how energy communities, flexibility, and demand reduction can support a fairer UK energy transition.
- Building: validating Power Haven, which connects data-centre batteries to electricity-grid flexibility needs.
- Writing: selected essays about energy, AI, institutions, and society on Substack.
- Podcast: 2Humans, co-hosted with Ross Horlock, discussing AI, energy, economics, and politics.
